events.what: Burungale, Skinner, Tian and Wan prove the p-part of BSD at supersingular primes for analytic rank 0 or 1, yielding infinite families of quadratic twists of non-CM curves over Q satisfying full strong BSD
Banwait and Huang identify 36,687 LMFDB curves of conductor at most 500,000 admitting such infinite twist families
Self-published full-proof claims (Zenodo/Shimizu, SSRN 'Relational Field Theory', preprints.org 'Iran Formula')
events.credibility_reason: Millennium problem; self-published solo claims in non-refereed venues, no expert uptake, later specialist work (BSTW follow-ups) treats BSD as open.

judgement.doubts: BSTW is still an unreviewed preprint as far as the record shows; this does not affect the partial tier.

corrections.why: F1: the record itself says BSTW 'settles BSD for an explicit infinite (but density-zero...) family of curves, leaving the general conjecture open — a textbook case settled'; scope is case, so the tier is partial regardless of review status.
